\section[l'ambiente]{l'ambiente — the environment}

\label{lesson:IT-C169-ambiente}



\begin{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: l'ambiente}
\textbf{l'ambiente} — \textquotedblleft{}the environment\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{ambiente} $\leftarrow$ Latin \emph{ambiens}, \textquotedblleft{}going around, surrounding\textquotedblright{}, from \emph{ambire} — a learned borrowing. (EtymDB 2.1 records the Latin word.)
\end{cousinweb}
